declared_by: Claude (Opus 5.5) working in Tim Hulshof's project repository
purpose: Select organism-level datasets for an independent evaluation of a frozen, fitness-blind curation method for automatically reconstructed (CarveMe / EMBL GEMs) draft models, as required by docs/studies/evaluation-protocol-v1.md. Criteria are declared before any candidate organism's phenotype file is downloaded or read.

source.fitness: Fitness Browser (fit.genomics.lbl.gov), organism list and per-organism tables as served on the selection date
source.draft_models: EMBL GEMs collection (github.com/cdanielmachado/embl_gems), model_list.tsv at the pinned commit 260d0f133802adbc151de4d7b14fb34722e1d9f4

criteria: E1. The organism is in the Fitness Browser organism list on the selection date.
E2. It is not one of the nine organisms with archived downloads in this repository (development: Btheta, Putida, MR1, Smeli, Keio; quarantined: Bvulgatus_CL09T03C04, Koxy, SynE, DvH).
E3. It is a bacterium (archaea are excluded because the draft models come from CarveMe's bacterial universe).

E4. The EMBL GEMs collection contains a model for the same strain: genus, species and strain designation must match after normalising punctuation and known taxonomic renamings; an ambiguous or species-only match excludes the organism.

E5. The organism has at least 8 Fitness Browser experiments with expGroup 'carbon source' and no second condition other than DMSO; this count is computed by a script from the experiment metadata table without displaying condition names or any fitness value.
E6. Its carbon-source experiments use at most three distinct base media, so that the media can be mapped to BiGG components from the FEBA recipes; this is also computed by script.
panel_assignment: Eligible organisms are ordered by orgId and assigned at random (Python random.Random(20261003).shuffle) to panel A (first ceil(n/2), used for the first frozen method) and panel B (remainder, reserved untouched for a later method). No organism is replaced after assignment; an organism that later fails a technical step (download, gene mapping, model loading) is reported as a failure, not substituted.
outcome_quarantine: Fitness tables (fit_logratios, fit_t) for panel A are downloaded only after the method freeze and the second (inputs) freeze are committed and recorded outside the repository.
Panel B fitness tables are not downloaded in this study.
Experiment metadata tables are used before the freeze only by scripts that print counts and media names; condition names are read for compound mapping only after the method freeze.
known_limits: Self-custodied: the same model family designs the method and runs the evaluation; separation is by recorded time order (git commits, an external project-document timestamp, download file times), not by an independent custodian.
Fitness Browser data have been public since 2015-2018 and may appear in frontier-model training data; no assumption is made either way.
The EMBL GEMs collection is historical (models built in 2017); results describe that collection, not current CarveMe output.
